card.name: Word before bears/emblazoned/decorated with
card.fires_on: A noun or adverb right before a verb meaning 'carries/displays' something, such as 'emblazoned with', 'bear his name', 'contain', or 'adorning'. It marks a thing that is about to be described by what is printed or shown on it.

modes.label: Item emblazoned with
modes.description: A object noun (blouse, table, box) just before 'was emblazoned with' a design or text.

modes.description: An adverb like now, usually, or often right before a verb saying what something bears or holds.

modes.label: Decorating tiles
modes.description: Part of a word or phrase about tiles or items decorating a surface.
modes.example: The mosque is popularly known as the Blue Mosque for the blue tiles<< ad>>orning the walls of its interior.
